name: Trail Sense
description: Quests look for places 15% further out, and exploring does 5% more against creatures, per rank.

name: Cartographer
description: 1 more ring of tiles explored around every new tile, per rank.

name: Pathfinder
description: The first 10 new tiles of a journey pay double XP, per rank (10, then 20).

name: Far Wanderer
description: New tiles more than 5 km from where the journey began pay 10% more XP, per rank.

name: Fog Breaker
description: Exploring does 25% more against legends.

name: Arcane Sight
description: A piece on the map is 20% more likely to be a rune stone, per rank.

name: Foresight
description: A rune shape does 6% more against creatures, per rank.

name: Ley Finder
description: A rune shape reaches creatures 500 m further away, per rank: 1.5 km, then 2 km.

name: Second Chance
description: 1 missed optional objective of a finished quest counts as done.

name: Rune Master
description: A rune shape does 25% more against legends.

name: Second Wind
description: Once a journey passes 10 km (5 km on foot), distance does 10% more against creatures, per rank.

name: Mountainborn
description: Opens the summit quests, and climbing does 10% more against creatures.

name: Endurance
description: The long-distance XP bonus pays 10% more, per rank.

name: Vanguard
description: Everything you do against elders and bounties does 10% more, per rank.

name: Giant Toppler
description: Climbing and distance do 20% more against legends.

name: Archivist
description: A note does 8% more against creatures, per rank.

name: Rumour
description: Chests pay 5% more coins, per rank.

name: Footnote
description: On a journey where you wrote a note, places found pay 20% more XP.

name: Historian
description: A note does 15% more against creatures at old and cultural places, per rank.

name: Loremaster
description: A note does 25% more against legends, and reaches a legend from 500 m away.
